_meta: G6 fragment (owner: ECON-AIRF6). CONTRACTS_G6: rules.g6_market (section 13, D27). New ids/keys only; numbers are PROVISIONAL balance fixtures. base_price = credits per unit at rest; step_pct = price change per unit bought (+) or sold (-) by anyone; drift_s = time for a price to drift back to base after the last trade (linear); sell_pct = sell price as % of the buy price; limit_per_window = units per resource per player per limit_window_s (fixed windows from tick 0); min_pct / max_pct clamp the price around base; requires_hq = trading needs a built HQ (the market opens from the HQ panel, no building).
